notices.title: Sabbath School Class
notices.body: Sabbath School is held every **Saturday** and **Sunday** at 9:00 AM. Everyone is cordially invited to attend.

notices.title: Gratitude Month Special Program
notices.body: Next week, a special Gratitude Month program will be held at **2:00 PM**. We warmly invite everyone to come in large numbers.

notices.title: Baptism Class Registration
notices.body: Registration has opened for everyone who wishes to take baptism classes. You may register at the church office until **July 15**.

notices.title: Youth Meeting
notices.body: All youth are cordially invited to attend this **Friday** at 5:00 PM in the church compound. There will be a special teaching program.

notices.title: Church Cleaning Day
notices.body: This coming Saturday, a comprehensive church cleaning will take place. Everyone is invited to come with cleaning supplies at **8:00 AM**.

notices.title: Thanksgiving Mass
notices.body: A special Thanksgiving mass will be held next **Sunday**. There will be a community breakfast after the service. Everyone is invited to attend.

notices.title: Winter Children's Program
notices.body:
This year's Winter Children's Program will be held **July 6 - 17**. 🌧

📍 Parents are asked to bring their children to church from Monday to Friday during these days. The program starts at **3:00 AM/PM**.

👉 We invite volunteers to help teach the children and assist the teachers.

👉 We also ask for donations of school supplies such as paper, color, pencils, scissors, glue, and any other teaching tools as well as children's toys.

👉 Those who would like to support by providing tea, breakfast, or lunch for the children can contact the children's teachers.

👉 If you would like to support financially, you may help us at this account: **Debora Lukas 1000568886244**

creed: I believe in God the Father Almighty,
And in Jesus Christ His only Son our Lord,
Who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
The third day He rose again from the dead;
And sitteth on the right hand of God the Father Almighty;
From thence He shall come to judge the quick and the dead.
I believe in the Holy Spirit;
